name: qfd_vm_bctl_t-bc2-422b0e7ba
purpose: Qwen TP8 VM bank control leaf (8 per region, 64 per die): reset relay, me / pop replica, the bank's control + address + mask pin flops and NRI relays, x tag chain, FIFO gate; 78 flops, one root. Replaces the per-bank part of gctl_t (region seams <= 300 um, no added edge). Bench = region-leaf miter vs the flat ot_qfd_vm_region_quarter + the three bctl mutants. Second cut: M5 PG stripes at 2.7 um (the first route closed TT/FF/DRC but its view failed child_lint (b): two stripes per net spanned 42 % of the narrow tile).
